option_relations.rationale: COVID-19 associated multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C) is a broader category that encompasses Pediatric inflammatory multisystem syndrome.
Kawasaki disease is a distinct inflammatory condition, though it shares some features with MIS-C, it is not directly related to the provided leaf.
Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C) with COVID-19 associated acute ischemic stroke is a specific presentation of the broader Pediatric inflammatory multisystem syndrome.
COVID-19–associated cerebral vasculitis (ischemic stroke) describes a specific neurological complication of COVID-19, but the provided leaf is a broader inflammatory syndrome.
